name: Andrea De Nittis
bio: Turin-based creator behind ZEROAISTUDIO, working in what he calls AI-native filmmaking. Writes, directs and produces every episode of the gothic horror series ALUCARD himself.
bioMore: De Nittis handles the writing, direction, visual development, editing, sound design, continuity and long-term worldbuilding of each ALUCARD chapter on his own. The series passed 30,000 YouTube subscribers within about four months of its first chapter, and individual episodes have drawn audiences ranging from the low hundreds of thousands up to more than 1.7 million views. Outside ALUCARD, he has made the fan film "Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver — Reimagining" and AI-driven commercial and music-video work for brands including Kraken Rum, RedBull, Heineken, Durex and NOA.
